ODI # 33
Prudential World Cup, 1975, Final
Australia v West Indies
Lord's, London
21 June 1975 (60-overs match)

Result: West Indies won by 17 runs
West Indies wins the 1975 Prudential World Cup

Umpires: HD Bird and TW Spencer
